forms.title: Contact
forms.template:
<label> Name
    [text* your-name autocomplete:name placeholder "Name"] </label>

<label> Mobile
    [tel* mobile-phone placeholder "Mobile"]</label>

<label> Email
    [email* your-email autocomplete:email placeholder "Email"] </label>

<label> Subject
    [text* your-subject placeholder "Subject"] </label>

<label> Message
    [textarea* your-message placeholder "Message"] </label>

[submit "Submit"]

mail.subject: [_site_title] "[your-subject]"
mail.body:
From: [your-name] <[your-email]>
Mobile: [mobile-phone]
Subject: [your-subject]

Message Body:
[your-message]

-- 
This is a notification that a contact form was submitted on your website ([_site_title] [_site_url]).

forms.title: Job application
forms.template:
[dynamic_hidden job-title "CF7_get_post_var key='title'"]
[text* your-name autocomplete:name placeholder "Name"]

[email* your-email autocomplete:email placeholder "Email"]

[tel* mobile-phone placeholder "Phone No"]

<label>Attach CV (pdf, doc/docx; size less than 6MB) [file* resume limit:6mb filetypes:pdf|doc|docx]</label>

[submit "Submit"]

mail.subject: [_site_title] Job application: [job-title]
mail.body:
Job: [job-title]
From: [your-name] <[your-email]>
Phone: [mobile-phone]

The CV is attached.

-- 
This is a notification that a job application was submitted on your website ([_site_title] [_site_url]).
